factual_claims.claim: Konsolidator A/S reported a significant improvement in financial performance for the year ended December 31, 2025, driven by its Resilient Growth strategy and the expansion of its product portfolio.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Management Review section states: '2025 has been a defining year for Konsolidator... factual_claims.claim: This improvement was primarily due to reduced marketing and external expenses following the outsourcing of marketing activities in 2024, as well as higher revenue.

factual_claims.source_evidence: The Financial Review 2025 section states: 'In 2024, Konsolidator decided to outsource many of the marketing department's activities. candidate_sentences.text: This improvement was primarily due to reduced marketing and external expenses following the outsourcing of marketing activities in 2024, as well as higher revenue.

factual_claims.claim: Key operational metrics highlighted both successes and challenges.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Corporate Matters section discusses multiple metrics: 'Customer retention was calculated to be 87% in 2025... NPS score decreased to 19 in 2025... candidate_sentences.text: Key operational metrics highlighted both successes and challenges.

factual_claims.claim: However, the ARR churn rate increased to 12.6% from 10.5%, attributed to competition from ERP systems and the evolving needs of customers for FP&A tools.

factual_claims.source_evidence: The SaaS Metrics 2025 section states: 'In 2025, ARR churn rate was 12.6% compared to 10.5% in 2024... candidate_sentences.text: However, the ARR churn rate increased to 12.6% from 10.5%, attributed to competition from ERP systems and the evolving needs of customers for FP&A tools.
